requirements.text: Deep practical expertise in Germany's employment, regulatory and People compliance landscape
End-to-end employee relations experience, including exits, probations and grievances
Experience working with a works council
Track record of independently building or improving People processes in a fast-paced, changing organisation
Experience partnering with operational stakeholders and influencing leaders
English sufficient for effective collaboration with global colleagues
Ability to attend the office 2 to 3 days per week, ideally 3

resumes.text:
Sophie Brandt
Berlin, Germany

Summary
HR professional with seven years of experience in German mid-size companies. I focus on people operations that are compliant, clear and easy for managers to use.

Experience
Senior People Partner, Kestrel Mobility GmbH, Berlin (April 2021 to present)
- Owned employee relations end to end for 600 staff, covering probation reviews, grievance handling and exit interviews, and coordinated outcomes with legal counsel.
- Redesigned the leave-request and absence workflow for 800 employees, cutting approval time from 12 days to 2.
- Partnered with operations directors and plant leaders to influence headcount planning and shift design.
- Served as an elected representative on a staff forum at a Canadian subsidiary, a non-German body with its own rules.
- Colleagues describe me as the approachable first point of contact on the shop floor and in the office.

HR Business Partner, Lindenhof Manufacturing, Stuttgart (2018 to 2021)
- Supported three plant sites on policy questions, absence management and disciplinary procedures.
- Built a monthly people dashboard for the leadership team.

Education
B.A. Human Resource Management, Hochschule Rhein-Neckar (2014 to 2018)

Skills
German (native), English (fluent, business level), personal data protection basics, HRIS administration, Workday reporting.

Availability
Based in Berlin. I work from the office three days a week alongside leadership and the wider team.

Jonas Weber
Berlin, Germany

Summary
HR coordinator with two years of experience in a growing services firm. I am organised, practical and keen to build a stronger people function.

Experience
HR Coordinator, Brightline Services GmbH, Berlin (January 2024 to present)
- Handled probation reviews, grievance intake and exit paperwork for a 250-person firm, passing complex cases to the HR manager when needed.
- Reworked the onboarding checklist for new hires, cutting first-week paperwork by half.
- Maintains payroll change requests and holiday records in the HR information system.
- Team members say I am easy to talk to and quick to respond to questions.

HR Assistant, Ferrum Trading Ltd, London (2022 to 2023)
- Supported the London HR team with recruitment logistics and contract administration.
- Completed a short course on UK employment law and worked on policy updates for the UK staff handbook.

Education
Bachelor of Arts, Business and Psychology, University of Leeds (2018 to 2021)

Skills
German (native), English (fluent), Microsoft Excel, BambooHR, Outlook and Teams.

Availability
Works fully remotely from Hamburg, where I have a home office. I prefer remote work and have not yet spent regular days in an office.

Priya Nair
Berlin, Germany

Summary
Backend software engineer with seven years of experience in fintech and payments. I enjoy building reliable systems and working with product teams on clear technical plans.

Experience
Senior Backend Engineer, Ledgerly Payments GmbH, Berlin (2021 to present)
- Designed settlement services handling several million transactions per day, with a focus on uptime and audit logs.
- Improved the release pipeline for the payments platform, cutting deploy time from 2 hours to 10 minutes.
- Worked with product managers to scope sprint roadmaps and estimate engineering effort.
- Based in Berlin, I am in the office three days a week with my squad.

Backend Engineer, Quantum Savings Ltd, Amsterdam (2018 to 2021)
- Built REST APIs and reconciliation jobs for a savings product, with automated tests and monitoring.

Education
M.Sc. Computer Science, Technical University of Delft (2015 to 2017)

Skills
Python, Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Kubernetes, Terraform, observability with Grafana and Prometheus.

Languages
English (fluent), Hindi (native), basic German (A2) from evening classes.
